# ColorTreeEmbedded

## Summary

The embedded format of the `ColorTree` card: a compact, display-only strip showing the picked swatch, its hex value, and its Munsell notation. When no chip has been picked yet it says so. All interaction lives in the isolated format. Paints with the linked theme's `--card` / `--card-foreground` pair, falling back to the card's night-sky brand when no theme is linked.

## Import

```javascript
import { ColorTreeEmbedded } from '../components/color-tree-embedded';
```

## Usage

Wired as the card's embedded format:

```gts
export class ColorTree extends CardDef {
  static embedded = ColorTreeEmbedded;
}
```

Rendered wherever a `ColorTree` appears at embedded size:

```hbs
<@fields.colorTree @format='embedded' />
```
